text.div: Patient reports occasional morning headaches since last visit. She denies dizziness, chest pain, or shortness of breath. Medication adherence confirmed — Lisinopril 10 mg daily and Atorvastatin 40 mg nightly. Patient attributes symptoms to increased work-related stress. Live browser edit.
BP: 148/92 mmHg (elevated). Weight: 68 kg (stable). HR: 74 bpm, regular. Respiratory rate: 14/min. No peripheral oedema. Auscultation: clear lung fields bilaterally.
Essential hypertension — suboptimally controlled. Likely exacerbated by psychosocial stressors. Hyperlipidaemia — stable on current therapy.

1. Increase Lisinopril to 20 mg daily for improved BP control.
2. Monitor for ACE inhibitor-related dry cough; switch to ARB if symptomatic.
3. Order basic metabolic panel (BMP) — check renal function and electrolytes prior to next visit.
4. Home BP monitoring daily — log and bring to follow-up.
5. Follow-up appointment in 6 weeks.
6. Counsel patient on stress management and lifestyle modification.

Grounding score: 40/100. Hallucination risk: high. Supported 8, unsupported 12, conflicts 0.
